evidence: Two-year GCM tests at 15 levels, one realization each from the design climate's year-19 restart carried onto the levels: the mass-flux scheme (--convection massflux, massflux_fortran.py) against the simplified Betts-Miller baseline with the same longwave correction, the provisional refit and the carried correction in turn. They are the first two years of a spin-up, so they show the direction and early size of the scheme's effect and not a settled climate. The CM1 numbers are the settled boxes (the sea box's third lunar day, the land box's second). The bit checks compare the GCM's own outputs and restarts.
reading_rule: gcm_trigger[run][site][quarter]: the scheme's surface test parcel (massflux.trial) on the run's own 3-day mean site columns over years 0-1: the share reaching its cloud with kinetic energy to spare, the inhibition it meets below its level of free convection (J/kg), its condensation level, the depth of the clouds it reaches and the surface fluxes (W/m2, upward). bit_check: the month trials on 10, 14 and 15 levels without the scheme, run on the patched source, against the earlier months; smoke: the smoke month beside the Betts-Miller month. longwave_check: plasim_longwave check on both runs' year 1. stages[stage][run]: as levels_l15_test.json reads (rain by quarter sunrise-noon, noon-sunset, sunset-midnight, midnight-sunrise in mm/day at the Near-side Sea's and the land box's cells; the sea site's upper air on the box's levels at upper_air_heights_km; the sites' lowest level, on 15 levels the lowest 0.6 km, with PlaSim's 2 m air, which reads the 0.3 km level; the yearly summaries' means and the top two levels, water in ppmv). criteria[pair][stage]: the brief's (a) upper air at 41.8 and 55.8 km, the share of the baseline's gap to CM1 closed (at least half); (b) the sea's night at most 0.5 mm/day, evening at least two-thirds of CM1's, afternoon within half to one and a half times CM1's; (c) the land's afternoon nearer CM1's than the baseline's, its morning at least 1 mm/day; (d) the sea's lowest 0.6 km vapour no further from CM1's lowest 0.5 km than the baseline's; (e) the imbalance at the top of the air within 3 W/m2 of the baseline's, with the ground's shift; (f) the top two levels. pairs: each run's configuration, its differences from the baseline's and the seconds each year took.
